title: Self-Healing Orphan Tasks & Board Reconfiguration Safety Engine
author: agent-developer
summary: Implemented Self-Healing Orphan Tasks & Board Reconfiguration Safety Engine. Dynamic fallback in ensure_task_board_id maps missing/deleted board IDs to active_board_id, and missing column IDs to the board's first column (backlog). Zero invisible tasks guarantee in KanbanBoard. Drawer never crashes or silently unmounts on board updates. Added Board Reconfiguration Safety Invariant to cvh-dev system prompt.
